text:
maria: Heads up — seeing a cluster of long-lived SSE streams for tenant `acct-42` spin into a reconnect loop every ~30s. Console just shows `stream reset` with no error tag.

maria: Quick grep in proxy logs shows an odd mid-stream response: 
```
auth-gw -> client-proxy: 204 No Content (X-Auth-Action: revalidate)
proxy -> backend: connection close
client: reconnect backoff ~30s
```

lee: 204 from auth? That smells like the revalidate endpoint returning 204 when it wants to signal token refresh. SSE clients treat 204 as a clean close and then backoff+reconnect — causes churn.

camille: Was there any routing/region failover around that time? We had a shard bounce at 12:14 UTC. Could be sticky session lost and auth proxy hitting a new instance with config drift.

maria: timeline matches the shard flip exactly. Telemetry shows reconnect rate spike coincident with route swap.

jordan: Two parts: (1) proxy behavior — if auth needs revalidation it should send explicit close reason header so clients can surface it (not silent 204). (2) Console/metrics — we need a distinct metric label for disconnect reasons so this doesn't just show as "stream reset". Proposal: add header `X-Stream-Close-Reason: auth_revalidate` on 204/401 closes, and record metric `stream.disconnect.count{reason=...}`.

lee: I worry about switching to 401 full-time — some legacy clients may not handle it and will drop permanently. Adding `X-Stream-Close-Reason` is low-risk and gives us telemetry immediately.

devx: SDK note: current JS/Go SSE clients treat 204 as benign close and just reconnect. We can ship client patch to read `X-Stream-Close-Reason` and surface in console UX (lastDisconnectReason). We'll need a minor SDK bump and a changelog.

eng-bot: incident-alert: stream_reconnect_spike acct-42 — 5.2k reconnects/min at 2026-03-18T12:14:02Z :rotating_light:

camille: Ok let's not break customers. Action plan: 1) Add `X-Stream-Close-Reason` header in proxy for revalidate events (canary). 2) Emit `stream.disconnect.count` with reason label. 3) Devex to add a "Last disconnect reason" column in Console stream inspector and show last response headers. 4) SDK team to read header and mark UX.

maria: I'll add the header and metric in a small proxy patch and run a canary to 10% of traffic tomorrow 10:00 PT.

lee: I'll own the metric instrumentation and dashboards. Will add an alert on `stream.disconnect.count{reason="auth_revalidate"}` > 100/s for a minute.

jordan: I'll file a Console ticket for the inspector change and wire it into the stream timeline.

devx: I'll draft SDK PRs and a developer note for the changelog.

maria: ETA for full rollout depends on canary; target for broader deploy EOD Friday if canary stable. :+1:

camille: nicetouch — and we should audit other places that return 204 mid-stream (proxy, ingress, CDN). Might be broader.

maria: Good call. I'll run a grep across edge logs after the canary.

lee: TL;DR: add explicit close reason header + metric + console column, canary first, then consider changing status code if needed. :thumbsup:
